instruction: Find the help section for account-related questions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Ticketek homepage to find help section related to account management. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains both help/support context AND account topic.
metadata.verification_notes: Using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. Pattern verifies URL contains both help/support/faq/contact AND account keywords to ensure it's actually a help section about accounts, not just any account-related page.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: The pattern '(help|faq|support|contact).*account|account.*(help|faq|support|contact)' requires BOTH help/support keywords AND account keyword in the URL
Pattern semantics are correct: Will match URLs like 'help/account', 'account/help', 'faq-account', etc., but NOT 'account/login' or standalone 'help' pages
Complete coverage: The regex pattern covers all reasonable variations of help sections about accounts (help, faq, support, contact combined with account in either order)
Appropriate verification method: Using URL pattern matching is appropriate for this navigation task, as help sections typically have descriptive URLs
Getter extracts correct state: get_active_tab_info retrieves the active tab URL which is exactly what's needed to verify navigation to the help section
